title: Forge Rule Result v1
description: Structural schema for a ForgeRuleResult — one diagnostic produced by evaluating one rule against one ForgeEvaluationContext. The CURRENT backend's ValidationResult (backend/jewelmind/validation/rules.py) is a strict subset of this shape: ruleId, severity, message, parameter (-> fieldPath), suggestedValue. Every additional field here is either PLANNED or derivable at the API layer today. See docs/bible/06-forge/098-rule-result-and-diagnostics.md.

status.description: CURRENT behavior only ever surfaces FAILED results (validate_definition() returns diagnostics only for rules that fired, per backend/jewelmind/validation/engine.py). PASSED/SKIPPED/NOT_APPLICABLE are PLANNED, for a future full-evaluation-trace mode.

timestamp.description: PLANNED — the current ValidationResult carries no timestamp; generation-level timestamps live on ModelRecord.generated_at instead, outside this result shape.
